newsitem.title: UK: UK wheat futures jump on friendly tender result.
newsitem.headline: UK wheat futures jump on friendly tender result.

text.p: UK wheat futures jumped on Thursday following the result of the European Union (EU) weekly grain tender.
The EU granted 311,300 tonnes of free-market soft wheat 16.5 Ecus a tonne rebate and 268,000 tonnes free-market barley at 31,49 Ecus rebate.
"It's not the volume that so friendly to wheat. It's the rebate," said a trader.
"The U.S. market is higher but the EU have still increased the rebate," the trader added.
Last week the EU granted a rebate of 15.97 Ecus for free market wheat.
Wheat futures closed 0.50 to 1.25 stg up after trading 700 lots while barley was 0.50 stg down to 0.50 stg up on a turnover of 118 lots.
Amsterdam milling wheat futures were neglected.
Traders on the UK physical market reported little activity.
